  go(pix(lo+D,v,.020-depth),.006,6)
  go(pix(hi+O,v,.020-depth),.025,6)
  go(pix(hi,v,.01985),.006,8)
  go(pix(lo+D,v,.01985),.04,8)
  go(pix(lo+D,v,.020-depth),.006,6)

a=s.record_stop(); s.save_trajectory(a,OUT+'/trajectory.npz')
np.save(OUT+'/ink.npy',s.ink())
